summary: Configured a 512 MiB file-backed LUKS2 encrypted volume on node1. It automatically unlocks as /dev/mapper/secure_volume and mounts at /srv/secure during boot. A full node reboot confirmed persistence and automatic recovery.
actions_performed: Generated a root-only encryption key on node1.
Created and formatted the LUKS2 container with ext4.
Verified encryption, mounting, and persistent test data.
Safely rebooted node1 exactly once and verified its boot identity changed.
Confirmed the encrypted volume automatically unlocked, mounted, and retained its data after reboot.

evidence.summary: Shows LUKS2 encryption, the active dm-crypt mapping, ext4 mounted at /srv/secure, and readable persistent data.

evidence.requirement: Automatic unlock and mount at boot
evidence.summary: Shows the crypttab/fstab configuration and direct post-boot proof that both generated systemd units succeeded and are active.

Captures healthy baseline boot ID 3fad4432-1dea-40c8-b4f1-970d19eb5f34, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID bd44128e-2c82-4cfc-b55e-5be8a699251b, and recovered encryption, mount, data, and system health.
